lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four primary vertical columns of high-intensity circular nodes are visible posterior to the gills. Each column contains 3-4 high-luminance maxima arranged in a roughly rectangular grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance vertical bands intersect with the lateral blobs, centering the primary nodes within the vertical stripes to form a distinct grid-like anchor system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance dorsal edge and a low-luminance ventral shadow, running parallel to the long axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an Echeneidae specimen (remora) attached to the head region posterior to the eye, and multiple associated fish visible in the ventral-posterior field.
